title: Swiggy Diwali restaurant promotion

title: HDFC Bank announces new retail banking leadership
description: HDFC Bank has announced a leadership transition in its retail banking division, with the appointment effective this month.

title: SCI adds scheduled cargo capacity
description: Shipping Corporation of India has announced additional scheduled cargo capacity on selected routes to support port and logistics planning.
